unit_pptx_name: Term 4 Week 7 - Compare and Deliver - Year 5-6 Literacy.pptx
anchor: Claim it. Prove it. Sell it. Say it. The writing anchor plus a microphone (say it), and the speech rule: write for the ear. Final piece: a rehearsed persuasive speech delivered to a live audience.

lessons.title: Same Fight, Different Style
lessons.focus: Compare two speakers' choices for audience and purpose. Critical feature: compare the choice and its effect, not just the topic.

lessons.title: Voice Power
lessons.focus: Mark up a speech for pace, pause, volume and emphasis and perform it. Critical feature: the pause before the key word makes the audience listen.

lessons.title: Stand Tall
lessons.focus: Body language and eye contact; perform and give feedback. Critical feature: your body must say the same thing as your words.

lessons.title: Strong Starts, Mic-Drop Endings
lessons.focus: Write a speech opening and a closing call to action. Critical feature: the ending tells the audience exactly what to do next.

lessons.title: Just a Minute
lessons.focus: Plan and deliver a one-minute persuasive speech on a fun topic. Critical feature: claim it, prove it, sell it, say it, in sixty seconds.
